core_obligations: For an arbitrary R'-module N, use the canonical identification of N tensor over R' with R' tensor M with N tensor over R with M (proof lines 9112-9114).

Deduce that the exactness properties of the functor tensoring over R' with R' tensor M are inherited from those of tensoring over R with M, giving flatness, and faithful flatness by the same identification (proof lines 9114-9116).
proof_roadmap: Identify the base changed tensor functor with the original one over R (proof lines 9111-9114).
Transfer exactness across that identification (proof lines 9114-9117).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if M is flat, respectively faithfully flat, over R and R to R' is a ring map, then the base change M tensor R' is flat, respectively faithfully flat, over R' (statement lines 9105-9109). The proof does not chase exact sequences: it observes that for every R'-module N the module N tensor over R' with R' tensor M is canonically N tensor over R with M, so exactness of the base changed functor is exactly the exactness of the original one, faithful flatness following from the same identification (proof lines 9111-9117). The canonical isomorphism carrying the whole statement is the content, and the author writes it down. H2.
